# ROTD Developer Wiki

> Exports, events and APIs of the ROTD FiveM resources, with parameters, return values and examples. Full text of every page in one file: https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/llms-full.txt

## How to use these docs

- Read https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/llms-full.txt first: it is every page in one file, with the rules for writing code at the top.
- https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Export-Index.md lists every export A to Z with its side (server / client / shared).
- Only use exports that are documented. Never invent an export, parameter or return value.
- The website itself needs JavaScript. The files in this list are plain Markdown and need none.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Changelog.md): What changed in the exports and in these docs. Newest first. Add a line here whenever an export is added, renamed, changed or removed, so developers can see it.
- [Common-Mistakes](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Common-Mistakes.md): The errors that come up most when calling ROTD exports. Each one shows the wrong way, the right way and why.
- [Getting-Started](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Getting-Started.md): How exports, client and server sides, player identifiers and registration hooks work in the ROTD pack. Read this once, every other page builds on it.
- [Home](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Home.md): Documentation for the exports, events and APIs of the ROTD resources, with examples.
- [npc_guide](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/npc_guide.md): Quest NPCs, quest progress, and the currency exchange market.
- [rotd_blips](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_blips.md): Discoverable map blips and POIs. Its exports give positions where building should be blocked; rotd_zones uses them for its no-build gate. Called from the client (the config is shared, so server use also works).
- [rotd_bridge](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_bridge.md): The shared layer between ROTD resources and your framework, inventory and optional partner resources. A resource never calls QBCore, ox_inventory and so on directly: it asks the bridge.
- [rotd_classystem](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_classystem.md): Classes, skills, XP and modifiers. Modifiers are multipliers (1.0 = normal) such as meleeDamage. Skills carry effects with numeric or boolean values.
- [rotd_leaderboard](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_leaderboard.md): Read-only stat lookups from the player_stats table. All exports are server side and take a cid (character id, string). Unknown players return 0.
- [rotd_loots](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_loots.md): Searchable loot props and containers, plus the "loot sense" scan.
- [rotd_recyclers](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_recyclers.md): Scrapping stations. The only exports are notification helpers (client side).
- [rotd_scavs](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_scavs.md): AI scavenger squads that loot corpses and stashes. Two server exports let other systems change what a scav carries. A scav is identified by its network id (netId, number).
- [rotd_squad](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_squad.md): Squads, reputation, per-player stats and squad building access.
- [rotd_zones](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd_zones.md): Zones, radiation, resistance, infection hooks and zombie names. Call exports with exports.rotd_zones:Name(...) (or exports['rotd_zones']:Name(...)).
- [rotd-minigame](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/rotd-minigame.md): Skill-check style minigames shown as a NUI: lockpick, keypad, safe dial, wire splice and more. Client side only.
- [Small-Exports](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/Small-Exports.md): Tiny exports of two resources, rotd_events and rotd_mystery_merchant. Both list the vehicles they currently own, so cleanup scripts such as vehicle_spawner leave those vehicles alone.
- [vehicle_spawner](https://lysoon.github.io/rotd_tebexwiki/vehicle_spawner.md): World vehicles, damage and parts. Exports for event scripts, garages and zombie systems.
